Lake County surrounds Clear Lake, California's largest natural freshwater lake, with Lakeport and Clearlake as its towns and vineyards and pear orchards on the slopes. Repeated catastrophic wildfires have made insurance availability the market's binding constraint, and rebuilding, lakeshore water-quality rules, and steep geothermal-area terrain dominate development decisions.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: November 8, 2026
